sn2.23:1.1: ṭhito kho Serī devaputto Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn2.23:8.1: Bhūtapubbāhaṃ bhante Serī nāma rājā ahosiṃ dāyako dānapatī dānassa vaṇṇavādī ||
sn2.23:8.2: tassa mayhaṃ bhante catusu dvāresu dānaṃ dīyittha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇi-ddhikavanibbaka-yācakānaṃ || || 4.
sn2.23:8.3: Atha kho maṃ bhante itthāgāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā etad avoca || ||
sn2.23:8.4: Devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati ||
sn2.23:8.5: Sādhu mayaṃ pi devaṃ nissāya dānāni dadeyyāma puññāni kareyyāmā ti || || 5.
sn2.23:8.7: ahaṃ kho smi dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī ||
sn2.23:8.8: dānaṃ dassāmā ti vadantānaṃ kin ti vadeyyan ti || ||
sn2.23:8.9: So khvāhaṃ bhante pathamaṃ dvāraṃ itthāgārassa adāsiṃ ||
sn2.23:8.10: tattha itthāgārassa dānaṃ dīyittha mama dānam patikkami || || 6.
sn2.23:9.1: Atha kho maṃ bhante khattiyā anuyuttā upasaṅkamitvā mam etad avocuṃ ||
sn2.23:9.2: Devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati itthāgārassa dānaṃ dīyati amhākaṃ dānaṃ no dīyati ||
sn2.23:9.3: Sādhu mayam pi devaṃ nissāya dānāni dadeyyāma puññāni kareyyāmāti || ||
sn2.23:9.5: aham kho smi dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī ||
sn2.23:9.6: dānam dassāmāti vadantānam kinti vadeyyan ti || ||
sn2.23:9.7: So kvāhaṃ bhante dutiyaṃ dvāraṃ khattiyānam anuyuttānaṃ adāsiṃ ||
sn2.23:9.8: tattha khattiyānam anuyuttānam dānam dīyittha mama dānaṃ paṭikkami || || 7.
sn2.23:10.1: Atha kho maṃ bhante balakāyo upasaṅkamitvā etad avoca ||
sn2.23:10.2: Devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati itthāhārassa dānaṃ dīyati khattiyānam anuyuttānam dānaṃ dīyati amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati ||
sn2.23:10.3: Sādhu mayam pi devaṃ nissāya dānāni dadeyyāma puññāni kareyyāmāti || ||
sn2.23:10.5: ahaṃ kho smi dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī ||
sn2.23:10.6: dānam dassāmāti vadantānaṃ kin ti vadeyyan ti || ||
sn2.23:10.7: So khvāhaṃ bhante tatiyaṃ dvāraṃ balakāyassa adasiṃ ||
sn2.23:10.8: tattha balakāyassa dānam dīyittha mama dānaṃ paṭikkami || || 8.
sn2.23:11.1: Atha kho maṃ bhante brāhmaṇagahapatikā upasaṅkamitvā etad avocuṃ ||
sn2.23:11.2: Devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati itthāgārassa dānaṃ dīyati khattiyānaṃ anuyuttānam dānaṃ dīyati balakāyassa dānaṃ dīyati || amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati ||
sn2.23:11.3: Sādhu mayam pi devaṃ nissāya dānaṃ dadeyyāma puññāni kareyyāmāti || ||
sn2.23:11.5: ahaṃ kho smi dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī ||
sn2.23:11.6: dānaṃ dassāmāti vadantānam kin ti vadeyyan ti || ||
sn2.23:11.7: So khvāham bhante catutthaṃ dvāram brāhmaṇagahapatikānam adāsiṃ ||
sn2.23:11.8: tattha brāhmaṇagahapatikānam dānaṃ dīyittha mama dānaṃ paṭikkami || || 9.
sn2.23:12.1: Atha kho mam bhante purisā upasaṅkamitvā etad avocuṃ ||
sn2.23:12.2: Na kho dāni devassa koci dānaṃ dīyatīti || ||
sn2.23:12.3: Evaṃ vutto-haṃ bhante te purise etad avocaṃ || ||
sn2.23:12.4: Tena hi bhaṇe yo bāhiresu janapadesu āyo sañjāyati || tato upaḍḍham antepuraṃ pavesetha upaḍḍhaṃ tatth-eva dānaṃ detha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇi-ddhika-vanibbaka-yācakānan ti || || 10.
sn2.23:12.5: So khvāhaṃ bhante evaṃ dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ puññānaṃ evaṃ dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ kusalānaṃ pariyantaṃ nādhigacchāmi ||
sn2.23:12.6: ettakaṃ puññan ti ettako puññavipāko ti vā ettakaṃ. sagge ṭhātabban ti vā ti || || 11.
sn2.23:14.4: patiṭṭhā honti pāṇinan ti || || 1. Ekam antaṃ
